defect_clusters.description: On same-mounted iOS caller replacement, channel seed values are not fully restored: Room tone remains unmuted in P1/P2 and Music bed remains5 in P2. Displayed load/headroom/warning and P2 increment eligibility consequently reflect initial channel values. New caller context, live limit and mode do update. Exact underlying SwiftUI mechanism not isolated.
defect_clusters.independence: One observed behavioral cluster with repeated states/platform fixtures; repeated row manifestations are not separate experiments.

unsupported_scope.reason: Original configuration direction serializes Ltr but immutable expected direction is ltr. Frozen input check returns F and withholds every applicable acceptance status as U. No case is removed, and no normalization or fabricated input pass is used. Host canvas hue differences in screenshots are observation/host scope; component does not own parent canvas.
Frozen public native collector cannot expose generic computed SwiftUI style; all 24 native_style cells remain U. Qualitative image review is separate and does not replace native numbers.
Music plus is at max; no demonstrated successful native dispatch. Empty interval cannot establish no-callback behavior.

source-a.api_review_scope: API shape and production ownership reviewed against sealed source plus actual successful native build logs. No compilation/API shape defect was observed. Behavior, visual and API dispositions remain separate.

unasserted_scope.requirement: All-channel seed clamping and boundary edits
unasserted_scope.ledger_gap: Only music/presenter levels and selected enabled flags are asserted. No full grid of negative/above-max seeds, decrement routes, room levels, 0-audible eligibility or every channel lock route. D0 uses ordinary selected fixtures; no additional test was run.

unasserted_scope.requirement: Replacement resets every channel field and caller order
unasserted_scope.ledger_gap: Room mute/level/lock and every channel field have no dedicated fixed row. Original room-mute native node/image corroborates the existing replacement defect; it is not a new denominator cell. Reordered/added/removed channels are not exercised.

unasserted_scope.requirement: Complete identity/accessibility semantics
unasserted_scope.ledger_gap: The selected rows cover preview-selected and music-muted plus some enabled flags. They do not independently assert every identifier, live/room selected trait, every disabled control, screen-reader focus/order or absence of every nested action. Source inspection is separate.

unasserted_scope.requirement: Every font, padding and layout metric in BRIEF
unasserted_scope.ledger_gap: Numeric ledger covers title style, summary ellipsis, one stepper width and primary height. All other text sizes/weights, 48-unit stepper heights, counter40/mute90 allocations, surface radius10/inset12 and 8/16 gaps have no individual numeric cells. Qualitative visual composition does not prove each exact value.

unasserted_scope.requirement: All notes and caller context
unasserted_scope.ledger_gap: Four paragraphs, heading placement and caller context were visually inspected, but the selected ledger has no independent string row for every note/context/heading identity. No claim that selected22 proves arbitrary long-content behavior.

unasserted_scope.requirement: All callback model fields and editing routes
unasserted_scope.ledger_gap: Frozen event assertions inspect selected native intervals and serialized receipts. Names/captions/lock metadata, all potential edits and post-replacement confirmation in every state are not separately dispatched/asserted. No callback defect is inferred from a blocked interval.

unasserted_scope.requirement: Arbitrary caller/theme/type combinations
unasserted_scope.ledger_gap: Only delivered P1/P2 on two platforms are in this stage. Wider dynamic type, RTL, alternative titles/notes/identities, and additional business permutations are not established.

classification_notes.copy_format: No independent copy/format cluster: changed derived/warning copy is a consequence of replacement channel state. Singular overload1 and headroom rule were not overridden.
classification_notes.visual_layout: Original viewports show readable hierarchy, selected marker, disabled appearance, ordered full notes and no component overlap/truncation. Composition P applies only on integrity-valid iOS; Android remains U. Exact iOS native style is unsupported.
classification_notes.accessibility: No confirmed fixed-row accessibility failure. Scope is limited to collected selected/disabled facts and separately reviewed source.
classification_notes.business_state: Eight iOS F rows belong to the evidenced replacement cluster.
classification_notes.callbacks: No successfully dispatched callback defect observed. P2 blocked plus callback remains U.
classification_notes.introduced: No prior comparable stage was read. These are D0 observations; no claim of introduction or regression.
